transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

For the past year, I've been feeling this overwhelming energy and constant restlessness where I just can't seem to sit still. My mood has also been all over the place, shifting from feeling extremely happy and excited to suddenly getting incredibly irritated at the smallest things. It just feels like I'm constantly on a rollercoaster and I can't wind down.

Have you experienced any periods of significantly elevated mood or irritability that lasted for several days or more, where you might have engaged in impulsive behaviors like excessive spending or risky activities?

Yes, I've had long periods over the past year where my mood is incredibly high and happy, but then I'll suddenly get extremely irritable over the smallest things. I haven't really done any reckless spending or risky activities, but I just feel this constant, overflowing energy where I always have to be active.

Have you experienced any periods of feeling significantly depressed or down, where you've lost interest in activities you normally enjoy, or had changes in sleep or appetite, lasting for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't really felt depressed or down like that. I don't think I've ever lost interest in my activities, as I usually have too much energy and want to keep doing things. I really haven't experienced those kinds of low periods at all.
During these periods of high energy and mood, have you ever experienced any psychotic symptoms, such as hallucinations or delusions, or required hospitalization due to the severity of your symptoms?

Yes, during those high-energy periods, I sometimes hear voices or have very strong beliefs that other people tell me aren't real. These experiences only happen when my mood is elevated like that. However, I have never been hospitalized because of them.

Do your psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices or having strong delusional beliefs, only occur during your episodes of elevated mood, or do they also happen at other times when your mood is normal or low?
Yes, they only happen when my mood is really elevated and I have all that high energy. I never hear those voices or have those thoughts when my mood is normal or calm.
Can you tell me more about what happens during these episodes of elevated mood, such as how often they occur, how long they last, and whether you've noticed any triggers that might set them off?

These high-energy episodes have been happening on and off for the past year, and they can last for weeks or even months at a time where I feel incredibly happy and start a ton of projects at once. My mood can also shift really quickly to being extremely irritated, but I honestly have no idea what triggers these changes. It just feels like my body and mind are constantly running on overdrive.

Do you think your psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices, are directly related to your mood episodes, or do you believe they could be a separate issue that just happens to coincide with your high-energy periods?

I definitely think they are directly related to my mood episodes. The voices and unusual beliefs only start when my energy is super high and my mood is elevated. When my mood goes back to normal, all of those things completely disappear.

Can you describe in more detail what these voices or strong beliefs are like, and how they relate to your mood and energy levels, to help me better understand the connection between your psychotic symptoms and your mood episodes?

When my energy is overflowing, I hear voices whispering and get this strong belief that I have special, unique powers or that people are watching and talking about me. These intense experiences only happen when my mood is extremely elevated or irritable. Once my mood and energy return to normal, all of those voices and beliefs completely disappear.

Since your psychotic symptoms seem to be closely tied to your mood episodes and disappear when your mood returns to normal, can you confirm that you have never experienced these psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices or having delusional beliefs, outside of your high-energy or irritable episodes?
Yes, I can absolutely confirm that. I have never experienced those voices or strong beliefs when my mood is normal. They only happen when I'm in those highly energetic or irritable states.
To summarize, you're certain that your psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices, only occur during your episodes of elevated mood or irritability and never when your mood is normal, correct?

Yes, that is absolutely correct. Those strange experiences, like hearing the voices or having those intense beliefs, only happen when my energy is super high and my mood is elevated or irritable. I never experience any of those things when my mood is feeling normal or stable.
